text: why do they still suck ass. i grab on to it, and the whole slider resets, and its annoying as shit
resolution: Fixed the shared WorkbenchSlider drag reset: mouse-leave no longer clears the in-progress preview. Dragging now opens a full-surface capture overlay, keeps the value alive while the pointer leaves the track, and commits the last finite x-position on release. This addresses the grab-then-snap-back behavior on hmsc-int shared sliders. No commit made; working-tree fix only.
